name: microteams-applets
description: The applets shipped into the microteams CLI host: one screen applet per agent driver (Claude Code, Codex) and one that defines the `microteams api` command tree. Authored in TypeScript against the generated API client, bundled to goja-compatible JS.

scripts.build: npm run codegen && npm run typecheck && npm run build:cli && npm run screens && npm run copy
